question: If GARLIC is coded as 112 then CLOCK will be coded as:
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:** Sum of the opposite positional values of the letter**

GARLIC is coded as 112 →** 20 + 26 + 9 + 15 + 18 + 24 = 112**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1425796ef0e2acd41f007f1421b6832b4858811989b7229de64b6633062b6690.png] 

Similarly, CLOCK will be coded as: **24 + 15 + 12 + 24 + 16 = 91**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fd7f3e849a158f439740e577cdfba2c9f7cf3e7511db66f4e9d34fdabc4069.png] 

Hence,** 'option 1' **is the correct answer.
